item.description:
### New
- Patchy UI now speaks 36 languages. It follows the language set for it in System Settings › General › Language & Region. Patchy's own messages, under Show Details, stay in English. - **About Patchy UI** in the Patchy UI menu now shows the Patchy, Apache and PHP versions on your Mac. **Check for Updates…** is also in Settings › General.
### Fixes
- Choosing **Not Now** when offered password-free mode no longer cancels what you were doing. The change goes ahead and asks for your Mac password. - Dragging a site onto a group in the sidebar now works anywhere on the group, not only on its header. - In a narrow window, the buttons above a site no longer cut off their labels.
Still made for **Patchy 1.2.1**.

### Fixes
- Setting up password-free mode works again. Before, it failed after you entered your Mac password, with a message that a terminal is required. - If password-free mode still can’t be set up from the app, the message now explains how to turn it on from Terminal instead.
Still made for **Patchy 1.2.1**.

### Fixes
- Renaming a group now works. Before, the dialog opened empty and clicking Rename did nothing. Creating a group by clicking Create is fixed the same way. - After you add a site, the sidebar scrolls to it. - The bottom of the sidebar no longer sits on top of the site list.
Still made for **Patchy 1.2.1**.
